stem: $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter of circle M and $m(\widehat{AC}) = 50^\circ$. Arc ADC goes from A through D and B to C (the long way round). Complete: $m(\widehat{ADC}) = \ldots$. Drag the points to set the measure of arc ADC.
solution: Arc ADC goes from A through D and B to C, so it is the whole circle minus arc AC.

hints.text: Arc ADC is the long way round. Check which of the two arcs between A and C you set.
The arc measure is its central angle itself. Check which angle you have set.
Subtract the small arc from the measure of the whole circle.
